net-30.title: Net 30 Payment Terms
net-30.content: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice date. Late payments subject to 2% monthly interest.

net-15.title: Net 15 Payment Terms
net-15.content: Payment is due within 15 days of invoice date. Late payments subject to 2% monthly interest.

milestone-based.title: Milestone Payment Schedule
milestone-based.content: Payments tied to specific project milestones. Each milestone payment due within 7 days of completion.

upfront-50.title: 50% Upfront Payment
upfront-50.content: 50% payment required before work begins. Remaining balance due upon project completion.

demo-express.title: Express Payment Terms
demo-express.content: Payment due within 7 days. 5% discount for same-day payment.
